plain: To take by force or twist away

webster.text: To twist or extort by violence; to pull or force from by violent wringing or twisting; as, to wrest an instrument from another's hands.

more.text: To take or force from by violence.
To distort; to turn from truth or twist from its natural meaning by violence; to pervert.
Distortion; violent pulling and twisting; perversion.

example.quote: In all very numerous assemblies, of whatever character composed, passion never fails to wrest the sceptre from reason.
